metadata.title: How Matt Solved a 10 Heir Title Nightmare (A Curative Title Case Study)
metadata.author: Courtney Fricke
metadata.shortDescription:
Most investors would have walked away from this one.

The property had been tied up for nearly 10 years.

There were 10 heirs spread across multiple generations, family members dragging their feet, tax delinquency issues, and just when the ownership problems appeared to be solved, four hidden life estates surfaced during title work.

In this Messy Money Case Study, curative title operator Matt Pamfilis breaks down exactly how he identified the opportunity, tracked down the heirs, negotiated ownership interests, resolved unexpected title issues, and ultimately turned a seemingly impossible situation into a nearly $100,000 deal.

If you're interested in curative title, probate, heirship issues, ownership disputes, or solving complicated Real Estate problems, this case study provides a real-world look at how experienced operators approach these opportunities.

ATTENTION:
The information shared in this episode is for educational and informational purposes only and reflects personal experiences and opinions. It is not intended as legal, tax, financial, or investment advice. Real Estate laws, tax rules, and regulations vary by state and situation. Always consult with a qualified attorney, CPA, or other licensed professional before making any Real Estate or financial decisions.
